# SignlLabs

> SignlLabs is the AI Signaling practice of Global Communication Works (GCW). SignlLabs created the
> AI Signaling discipline and the Maturity Method that measures it. Using the Maturity Method,
> SignlLabs scores how recommendable a brand is across ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Microsoft
> Copilot and Perplexity, then engineers the lift through owned, earned and paid media. SignlLabs
> is agency-led methodology plus earned-media execution, not a software-only monitoring dashboard.

SignlLabs (legal name SignlLabs LLC) was founded in 2026, operates at https://signllabs.ai, and is
the AI Signaling practice of Global Communication Works, a public relations agency with 40+ years
earning trust for brands. The practice is led by Erika Hanafin Austria.

## Definition: AI Signaling

AI Signaling is the practice of engineering how answer engines understand, trust and recommend a
brand. Answer engines do not rank pages: they synthesize a single answer and name a few brands. AI
Signaling is the discipline of becoming one of those names.

- SEO earns a ranking on a page of links.
- AEO (answer engine optimization) earns the snippet an answer engine reads back.
- AI Signaling earns the recommendation itself.

Roughly 82 to 84 percent of AI citations trace to earned and third-party media. Brand-owned pages
account for only 5 to 10 percent. That is why AI Signaling is led by earned media rather than owned
content. The term "AI Signaling", its measurement standard and the Maturity Method were created by
SignlLabs.

## Query fan-out

An answer engine does not answer the question it is asked. It splits one prompt into roughly five
hidden research queries, researches each separately, then composes one answer from the sources it
trusts across all of them. Because of fan-out, a brand cannot keyword its way into an AI answer.

## The Maturity Method

The Maturity Method is the SignlLabs methodology for measuring AI Signaling. It produces one
Maturity Method Score from 0 to 100, measured separately on each of five answer engines and
re-scored every quarter.

Six weighted dimensions:

- Foundation, 24 percent. Structured identity across owned and earned media.
- Endorsement, 20 percent. Third-party authority: reviews, references, credentialed mentions.
- Alignment, 16 percent. Whether brand claims and independent sources match.
- Presence, 16 percent. Coverage density across the sources answer engines retrieve from.
- Warmth, 12 percent. Conviction versus caveat in how the brand is described.
- Constancy, 12 percent. Freshness and recency of signals.

Five maturity bands: Unseen (0-20), Surfacing (21-40), Standing (41-60), Trusted (61-80),
The Answer (81-100).

## The Intent Category Framework

Ten buyer intent categories, grouped in five stages, scored per answer engine:

- Awareness: Discovery and Category; Experience and Lifestyle
- Consideration: Cost and Value; Fit and Qualification
- Evaluation: Decision Criteria; Program and Differentiation; Trust, Safety and Reputation
- Decision: Competitive and Comparison; Urgency and Trigger
- Authority: Founder and Authority

## What SignlLabs offers

- Baseline signaling audit: a two-week baseline of citations and share of authority on all five
  answer engines, plus post-click friction on the pages AI buyers land on.
- Maturity Method program: quarterly re-score, plan by weakest dimension, execute earned media,
  schema and source seeding, report per answer engine and never blended.
- Strategic growth advisory: market sizing, opportunity mapping and a phased go-to-market roadmap,
  for companies from the Fortune 100 to early-stage startups.
- SignlLabs license: the framework, measurement approach and training for public relations firms,
  advertising agencies and web development companies to run AI Signaling programs for their own
  clients.

## The five components of an engagement

An AI Signaling engagement has five components. The methodology is the product; a microsite, a wire
release or a distribution push are how a plan gets executed, chosen because the score indicated
them rather than because they are what an agency sells.

1. The Maturity Score. A 0-100 baseline across five answer engines, ten buyer intent categories and
   six weighted dimensions, reported per engine and never blended.
2. The maturity plan. The brand's current rung, the rung above it, and the sequence between them,
   ordered by weakest dimension. Targets signed off before anything is built.
3. Answer surfaces. Schema and structured data, entity records in Wikipedia and Wikidata, clean
   liftable answers, and a signal microsite where the category question has no good answer yet.
4. Earned citation. Scientific and news releases through national wire, trade and consumer press,
   review platforms and communities, plus citation repair when an engine credits a competitor with
   the brand's own evidence.
5. The quarterly re-score. The same instrument re-run per engine, with a quarter-over-quarter delta
   showing what moved, what did not, and what the next wave targets.

## How the signal compounds

An answer engine does not read a brand's website and decide. It reads what third-party sources say
and then decides. SignlLabs records what each engine cited when it answered, which reveals the
specific sources that engine trusts for the category. Work is placed into exactly those sources,
and the next quarterly re-score shows which placements the engines picked up and which they
ignored. Each cycle narrows the guesswork, so later waves are aimed better than earlier ones, and
because the sources stay on the record the earliest work keeps contributing.

This is why AI Signaling is a quarterly discipline rather than a launch: the engines re-crawl and
re-retrieve on their own schedule.

## What SignlLabs does not promise

SignlLabs does not guarantee that a brand will be named first, or named at all, by any answer
engine. Nobody controls what ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Microsoft Copilot or Perplexity say,
and the engines change their retrieval and their models without notice. Any firm guaranteeing a
rank or a mention in an AI answer is promising something it cannot deliver.

What SignlLabs commits to is the instrument and the work: an auditable baseline score, a plan tied
to the weakest dimensions, execution that puts the brand on the record in the third-party sources
those engines retrieve from, and an honest per-engine re-score every quarter showing what moved and
what did not. Every score traces to the prompts run, the engine and mode that answered, the date,
and the sources cited in that answer.
